single_delta.name: opening_sheep_bias
preconditions: observable own placed and shed animal count is exactly zero
base action market is a list
exactly one BUY_ANIMAL COW quantity 2 order
exactly one BUY_ANIMAL SHEEP quantity 2 order
every market order is a nonempty list whose operation is a string
invariants: market list length and all other market orders remain unchanged
farmer and hands values remain unchanged
base action and input observation are never mutated
single_delta.fallback: Return the exact base-action object for malformed observation/action, any existing own animal, missing/duplicate target order, or any other BUY_ANIMAL order.

allowed_observable_inputs: current observation player index used only to select the current farm
current public farm tiles for own placed-animal count
current private shed for own held-animal count
prohibited_inputs: team, opponent, submission, notebook, or leaderboard identity/context
price, price-impact, forecast, SELL ranking, or market-response data

hypothesis.statement: For the same exact Tetsu-v16 opening shape, moving one animal unit from COW to SHEEP can improve paired performance without changing total animal quantity, base logistics, or market-order count.
